title: Certify the Decision, Not Every Score: Exact Top-k Selection from Few Evaluations
abstract: arXiv:2610.14996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Choosing a few robust algorithms or schedules can require evaluating every candidate under many adverse scenarios, even though an agent only needs to identify the winners. A predictor may suggest those winners, but cannot rule out a surprise in an unevaluated scenario. We introduce Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS), which returns the exact top-$k$ set as soon as remaining uncertainty cannot change it. CAS keeps guaranteed lower and upper bounds on Expected Shortfall (ES), the average loss in the worst scenarios. Its stopping test compares the worst admissible selected candidate with the best admissible excluded one; for information-disjoint Cartesian intervals this one-cut test is necessary and sufficient. Prediction has a separate role: selecting the next outcome to evaluate, never authorizing the decision. translated_title: 认证决策而非每个评分：从少量评估中实现精确Top-k选择
translated_abstract: 选择少数鲁棒算法或调度方案时，可能需要在许多不利场景下评估每一个候选者，即使决策者只需要识别出优胜者。预测器可以建议这些优胜者，但无法排除在未评估场景中出现意外的情况。我们提出了认证自适应选择，一旦剩余的不确定性无法改变结果，它就会立即返回精确的top-k集合。CAS对期望短缺（Expected Shortfall, ES）——即最坏场景下的平均损失——保持有保证的下界和上界。其停止测试将最坏的可采纳已选候选者与最好的可采纳未选候选者进行比较；对于信息不相交的笛卡尔区间，这种单切割测试既是必要的也是充分的。预测扮演着独立的角色：仅用于选择下一个要评估的结果，绝不能授权决策本身。对于采用精确单位成本查询的经验ES，我们以多项式时间计算出可能证明该结果所需的最少评估次数。
tldr: 提出认证自适应选择方法，通过维持期望短缺的保证上下界并进行单切割停止测试，在剩余不确定性无法改变结果时立即返回精确top-k集合，从而以尽可能少的评估次数认证决策。
en_tdlr: Proposes Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS), which maintains guaranteed bounds on Expected Shortfall and uses a necessary-and-sufficient one-cut stopping test to return the exact top-k set as soon as remaining uncertainty cannot change it, certifying the decision with the fewest possible evaluations.
